Mehbooba Mufti Joins Medical Interns' Protest in Kashmir

Former Jammu and Kashmir Chief Minister Mehbooba Mufti joined a protest by medical interns in Srinagar. The interns are demanding a stipend hike. Mufti participated in a midnight candlelight demonstration and stated that the failure to meet basic needs is deeply regrettable. She also issued a warning to the government regarding the situation.
